publication: Jewish Studies at the Turn of the Twentieth Century, Volume I (1999)
one_new_evidence: Whole-copy safe native visual inventory, with a separate disposition for every supplied viewer leaf.
preflight: Every candidate page was screened against extracted text, article ranges/titles and surrounding context before rendering. Bedman viewers80-86 were independently established as text-only by the existing chapter read. Expected manuscript reproductions belong to medieval Genizah/Haggadah material identified in captions/context; existing detailed inspection was retained rather than reopened.
method: All remaining safe pages were rendered natively at 250px page width into 16-page, four-by-four contact sheets and visually inventoried. A contact-sheet screen establishes presence/type of visuals, not a detailed figure read. Suspected additional structured layouts at viewers71 and339 were then opened as full pages at 1.7x PDF scale.

status_definitions.safe_native_visual_inventory_screened: native thumbnail visually screened for additional figures/tables/images only; not a detailed page/figure read
status_definitions.already_detailed_native_inspected: existing reference_coverage native inspection retained without claiming a new detailed reread
status_definitions.newly_detailed_native_inspected: native full-page inspection of a layout shortlisted by inventory screen
status_definitions.withheld_uncertain_front_matter: textless leaf whose image content cannot be established safe independently; not opened

additional_structured_layout_checks.author: Giron Blanc
additional_structured_layout_checks.result: Continuation of the typeset Hebrew transcription, with line numbering and apparatus markers; no manuscript image, geographic content, scale or north arrow.

additional_structured_layout_checks.author: Millard
additional_structured_layout_checks.result: Prose with six italicized prohibitions in a single typeset list; no additional table/image, caption, scale or north arrow.

preserved_gaps: Alba Cecilia printed361 note1 explicitly omits the final discussion of Spanish Vidduy versions; it is not supplied in this copy.
The separate modern-history VolumeII is outside this 652-viewer VolumeI copy.
Textless front-matter viewers1,3,7,15 remain uncertain native-image exceptions.
safety: No Copper Scroll full-scroll, segments21-22, XII8-12, unknown inventory facsimile, or fine Tell es-Sultan north-strip image was opened. Unresolved source0 viewers318-319 were not reopened.
page_hash_definition: SHA-256 of ASCII representation of page content-stream xref list concatenated with decoded content-stream bytes, in PDF order; coupled with source SHA-256 and viewer index. These are page-content locators, not hashes of displayed pixels or extracted underlying raster resources.
